Interface IFilterable<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of object contained in the filterable collection.
All Known Implementing Classes:

public interface IFilterable<T>
A generic interface for classes (like stores or collections) that support being filtered by a FilterCriteria.

      List<T> filter(FilterCriteria<T> fCriteria)
      Filters the collection based on the provided criteria.
